text: Gap pass (profession lens) wrote no rooms. The session's web-search budget (200 of 200) was already spent when the pass started, and every other route (WebFetch, curl) is blocked by the network, so no new gathering place, size or price could be seen at a URL. Rather than invent URLs, gap_profession.json holds an empty rooms list. Six candidate rooms that look genuinely missing and need a re-run with search budget: freelance GRE/GMAT tutors on marketplaces (v1, warm via GRE product); energy managers and auditors pursuing CEM/BEE certification (energy depth, search reach); Big 4 transaction-services/FDD associates moving to IB/PE (deal-docs depth, warm via finance colleagues); fractional CFOs and independent finance consultants (corporate-finance depth, search reach); B2B SDR and inside-sales team leads running outbound call teams (v4, AI voice/call-audit depth); online fragrance decanters and small perfume resellers (v2, fragrance depth, marketplace reach).
